[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I used another users format for this post as this is my very first trip report. There was more but I still can't remember it well. This is everything I remember about it.
User Background Information:
I am a young male. 5'10 tall, weigh 158lbs I have a very healthy weight, I have strong heart function and am also very athletic (Varsity hockey and lacrosse)
Preparation for Use:
This being my first psychedelic experience I had no idea what to expect for me other than trip reports I've read but I had heard that the NBOMe's are rather unpredictable in effect.
Administration:
T+0:00; 12:00am
- Took first blotter of approximately  500ug between gum and lip for 30 minutes.
- No noticeable taste.
I took the blotter at 12:00am and went to play some Black Ops II with friends.
T+0:30
- Minor Color Enhancements
Colors seemed to have more depth and were brighter but weren't very noticeable. Minor visuals weren't what I was going for I wanted to be shit fucked. I decided to take the rest of what I have. I took approximately 1500ug  doing so raised my amount  up to  2000ug in total. After I re-dosed I went back to gaming and played the waiting game
T+0:50 T+2:00
-Medium color enhancements (more than after 1st dose)
I needed to take a quick break to piss so I got up and walked to the bathroom. When I was done I walk back into my room to grab my phone which was charging at the time. I leaned over and picked it up and when I was back up I felt as if I was punched my Muhammad Ali. I was completely fucked at this point and the effects were still coming on. I  attempted to write a text to my friend telling him about my state and being unable to play any more. I must have takes me 2 minutes to type those few words. My phone keyboard was swirling around so I decided to lay down and let the Open and closed eye visuals come on.
T+2:10  T+3:00
- EXTREME closed eye visuals
- VERY strong open eye visuals
- Altered Perception of Time
- Inability to Distinguish Reality
- Tachycardia
I laid there for what I believe now to be 10 minutes though it actually felt like 2 hours. I was seeing a double helix with colors flowing through it in the middle appeared to be a black hole. I began falling through it the further I went the faster my heart rate became and the colors quickly turned to darkness and the happiness to fear. I wanted to change the scene I was in so I opened my eyes quickly. To have the fear disappear quickly.
T+3:00  T+4:30
- Intense out of body experience
- Auditory Hallucinations
- Inability to Distinguish Reality
Everything appeared to be out of focus for a while and after about ten seconds everything came into focus and I was standing at the end of my bed looking upon my body. I walked over to my body with a profound sense of calm as if I wasn't able to comprehend what was going on. Put two fingers on my neck feeling for a pulse. I felt none. I began to wonder if I was dead and this was what the afterlife or at least part of it was composed of. I walked out of my room into the hallway I flicked the light switch and nothing happened. I had heard that in lucid dreams or if you have an OBE while dying light switches don't do anything, I turned around and looked in the mirror and couldn't see anything. I quickly adopted this as the answer. I was dead. I left all my family and friends behind, I would never be able to say bye and they would be torn to pieces when they found me. I decided to continue to walk around and soak up possible the last images I would ever see of reality or this world. I noticed there was a darkness that was radiating from the doors around me and at the end of the hallway. I walked down the hallway and called out for help. I layer down there and cried for a good 20 minutes it seemed when I heard my dad calling out to me from downstairs I got up and rushed downstairs to see if there was a possibility I wasn't really dad and this was all just a massive bad trip. When I reached the bottom I stumbled and the scene blacked out. I 'woke' up from where I was laying and realized I wasn't dead. I opened my eyes and my walls were covered in bright neon geometric shapes. On the ceiling were complex equations literally solving themselves. I got up and felt an intense sense of euphoria begin to hit me in visible waves.
T+4:30  T+6:00
- Mild visual distortion and hallucination
- Strong body high
- Intense euphoria
I walked outside and laid down in the back yard starring into the sky. I began to ponder about deep, introspective questions and attempted to fix some of my fears in reality. I failed to eliminate my fears but did figure out the answers to some of those questions. I felt like the answers were being presented to me from the dark starry sky.
I went inside and had to piss again. The Erm Stream was rainbow colored. When I looked around some of the real symbols that were on the wallpaper began to shift around and move further into the wallpaper creating a depth to it.
T+5:00  T+7:00
- Intense Euphoria
- Body high remained
- Motor function returning to normal
I was back in my room again and decided to look at some youtube videos and do some research as to why that happened. I was not aware at the time of dosing that such intense experiences were possible with this drug. I ended up finding some info about one or 2 experiences like this. I wasn't able to read it at the time because all letters seemed to be moving around the page and the characters that weren't moving had special accent marks and such on them making it impossible to read.
T+7:00  T+10:00
- Mild euphoria and visual distortion
- Mild body high
I spent the rest of the night watching Netflix and listening to music which sounded and felt amazing. It felt like the music was pure euphoria flowing into my ears.  I wasn't able to sleep for 2 days after.
